out_items.name: Food separated and protected

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: raw fish, and raw beef over unwashed lettuce.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. CFM relocated raw fish and raw beef to the raw designated shelf in their cooking temperature.

out_items.name: Proper date marking and disposition

violations.title: RTE TCS Food Prepared On Site, Date Marking
violations.observation: The following refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food that is prepared on site is not used or discarded within 24 hours of preparation and was not observed to be date marked: observed coleslaw, salsa without preparation date.
violations.corrective_action: Refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety foods that are prepared on site and kept for more than 24 hours cannot have a shelf-life of more than 7 days, including the day of preparation. These food items must be marked with either the 'consume-by' date and/or 'preparation' date, color-coded labels, or another marking system/method that effectively indicates shelf-life that is clearly understood and properly used by the employees.CFM date marked coleslaw and salsa without

out_items.name: Approved thawing methods used

violations.title: Proper thawing methods used for TCS Foods
violations.observation: Observed the following food thawing using an improper method: Observed raw beef thawing in prep sink not completely submerged under running water, frozen soup on counters, and cooked frozen chicken on counter.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be thawed using one of the following methods: 1) under refrigeration that maintains the food temperature at 41F or less, 2) completely submerged under running water at a water temperature of 70F or below with a sufficient velocity to agitate and float off loose particles of food as long as held for period of time at a temperature of 41F or less, or 3) as part of a cooking process if the food is cooked as specified by Law or thawed in a microwave oven and immediately transferred to a conventional cooking process. CFM relocated raw, beef, frozen soups and cooked frozen chicken to the walk in refrigerator

out_items.name: Wiping cloths properly used and stored

violations.title: Wiping Cloths Stored in Sanitizer Solution
violations.observation: Wet wiping cloths used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces were observed stored on the counter. Observed wet wiping clothes in kitchen and bar counters.
violations.corrective_action: Wet wiping cloths are to be used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces and are to be held in a chemical sanitizer solution at the appropriate concentration between uses. CFM prepare 2 buckets of sanitizer and store wet wiping clothes in sanitizer.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Mops Allowed to Air Dry
violations.observation: Observed that mops are improperly stored between use. Observed mops store on the floor or upside down.
violations.corrective_action: Store mops in a position that allows them to air dry without soiling walls, equipment, or supplies. CFM use the mop rack to store the wet mops and allow air dry.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Cleanser, Availability
violations.observation: OBSERVED HAND SOAP AT HANDWASHING SINK BEHIND BAR.
violations.corrective_action: Provide hand soap at each hand sink to allow employees to properly wash their hands. CDI: SOAP PROVIDED TO SINK.

violations.title: Paper Towels Provided
violations.observation: OBSERVED NO PAPER TOWELS AT HANDWASHING SINK AT BAR AND IN KITCHEN.
violations.corrective_action: Provide paper towels at each hand sink to allow employees to properly dry their hands after handwashing. CDI: PAPER TOWELS SUPPLIED TO BOTH HANDWASHING SINKS.

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Designated Use
violations.observation: OBSERVED THE FOLLOWING IN THE HANDWASHING SINK BEHIND THE BAR: -DRINK MIX -PITCHER -FOOD CONTAINER
violations.corrective_action: Handsinks are to be used only for washing hands to encourage proper hand washing and to prevent contamination of cleaned hands. CDI: ITEMS REMOVED FROM SINK DURING INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Required records available: shellstock tags, parasite destruction

violations.title: Shellstock, Retaining Labels/Tags for 90 Days
violations.observation: The tags for the molluscan shellfish are not being retained for 90 days. OBSERVED RAW MUSSELS ONSITE AND FOOD STAFF WERE UNABLE TO PROVIDE ANY TAGS FROM THIS BATCH OR ANY IN THE PAST.
violations.corrective_action: The identity of the source of shellstock (oysters, clams, mussels) that are sold or served shall be maintained by retaining shellstock tags or labels for 90 calendar days from the date when the last shellstock from the container is sold or served using one of the following methods: 1) an approved record keeping system that keeps the tags or labels in chronological order correlated to the date when the last shellstock from a container are sold or served, 2) preserving source identification by using a record keeping system, and 3) ensuring that shellstock from one tagged or labeled container are not commingled with shellstock from another container with different certification numbers, different harvest dates, or different growing areas as identified on the tag or label before being ordered by the consumer. CDI: MUSSELS OBSERVED TO BE REMOVED FROM PREMISES. YOU MAY NOT SERVE SHELLFISH UNLESS THE TAGS ARE PROVIDED TO AND VERIFIED BY FAIRFAX COUNTY HEALTH DEPARTMENT.

out_items.name: Proper cold holding temperatures

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: OBSERVED HORCHATA AT 45F. PIC STATED IT WAS PUT IN ~5HRS PRIOR.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. CDI: HORCHATA DISPOSED OF. CEASE HOLDING TCS FOODS ABOVE 41F.

out_items.name: Consumer advisory provided for raw and undercooked food

violations.title: Consumer Advisory for Raw/Undercooked Food
violations.observation: A review of the menu with the foodservice operator indicates that there is no consumer advisory for the following food item(s) that may be served raw and/or undercooked: -CEVICHE
violations.corrective_action: If an animal food such as beef, eggs, fish, lamb, milk, pork, poultry, or shellfish is served or sold raw or undercooked the permit holder shall inform consumers of the significantly increased risk of consuming such foods by way of a disclosure and reminder using brochures, deli case or menu advisories, label statements, table tents, placards, or other effective written means. MI PUEBLO SPORT BAR & GRILL (Inspection Date: 09/17/2025) Page 2 of 4

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Ice As Coolant Not Used as Food
violations.observation: Ice used as a medium for cooling the exterior surfaces of food is also for beverage ice or used as food. OBSERVED ICE AT BAR BEING SERVED AND ALSO USED TO COOL A PITCHER OF LIQUID.
violations.corrective_action: After use as a medium for cooling the exterior surfaces of food, packaged foods, beverages, or cooling coils/tubes, the ice may not be used as food. CDI: ICE DRAINED.

out_items.name: In-use utensils properly stored

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Dispensing and/or in-use utensils improperly stored between use as follows: OBSERVED ICE SCOOP BEING STORED WITH HANDLE TOUCHING ICE AT ICE CONTAINER AT BAR.
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. CDI: ICE DRAINED AND ICE SCOOP TAKEN TO THREE-VAT SINK.

out_items.name: Single-use/single-service articles properly stored and used

violations.title: Single-Service/Use Items No Reuse
violations.observation: OBSERVED GARLIC CONTAINERS BEING RE-USED TO STORE VARIOUS FOODS IN WALK-IN COOLER.
violations.corrective_action: Manufacturer containers may not be reused for secondary storage of other foods because the containers are not durable enough for multiple reuse and become uncleanable. GARLIC CONTAINERS MAY NOT BE REUSED FOR FOOD STORAGE. OBTAIN NSF-APPROVED CONTAINERS OR THE EQUIVALENT.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, Durable/Smooth Materials
violations.observation: The nonfood-contact surface of the following equipment is not corrosion resistant, nonabsorbent, and/or smooth: OBSERVED FOIL BEING USED TO LINE SHELVES.
violations.corrective_action: Non-food contact surfaces of equipment that are exposed to splash, spillage, or other foods that require frequent cleaning shall be constructed of a corrosion- resistant, nonabsorbent, and smooth material. REMOVE ALL FOIL AND CEASE USING IT TO LINE SHELVING. IT IS NOT CLEANABLE NOR IS IT DURABLE.

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: DRINK MIXER USED TO HOLD HORCHATA.
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly.

violations.title: Ceasing Operations & Reporting (Voluntary for Imminent Health Hazard)
violations.observation: The permit holder failed to discontinue operations and notify the Health Department that an imminent health hazard may exist because of an emergency. Observed a sewage back up at their only hand sink.
violations.corrective_action: CFM called plumber who was able to snake out drain and clear the back up.

violations.title: PIC Duties, No Unnecessary Persons
violations.observation: Unauthorized personnel, such as children or customers, were observed present in the food preparation, food storage, or warewashing areas. Observed gentleman walking through the kitchen multiple times and staff informed me he was not an employee and they did not know who he was.
violations.corrective_action: Persons unnecessary to the food establishment operation are not allowed in the food preparation, food storage, or ware washing areas of the commercial establishment. Only approved tours or brief visits may be authorized by the Person in Charge or certified food manager if steps are taken to ensure that exposed food, clean equipment/utensils, clean linens, and single service items are protected from contamination.education provided on the importance of restricting access to food prep areas and gentleman removed.
